lines: A board for travellers' notes. Nothing useful is pinned on it yet.
Tip: each hall's order is scratched into the wall by the stairs. Ring the bells in exactly that order; a wrong bell only starts the row again.
The cracked bell in the old belfry rings once, though no one pulls the rope.
The toll does not fade. It turns, and listens back at you.
It is Hallowmur, the living bell. It has waited a long time for someone to answer.
